numeric_semantics: Python arbitrary-precision integers; JavaScript BigInt for grid counts, prime products, rational ratings and order quantities. Other input numeric fields are safe integers.
unicode_semantics: Passwords use Unicode code points; board and remaining identifier/string domains follow the explicit ASCII/lowercase contracts.

assumptions.basis: Public group preview only; no exact variant body

assumptions.text: Process ordered, at-most-once NEW/FILLED CSV events. NEW creates an order; an identical repeated NEW is a no-op, conflicting NEW returns false. FILLED requires matching side/symbol and positive quantity no greater than remaining. Invalid updates return false without mutation. status returns a fresh snapshot or null. FILLED retries are not deduplicated because the preview supplies no event ID.
